## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Clashofvlansbrah_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "This app refreshes every 5 seconds while you’re trying to type. Notion for desktop is great. This IOS platform is, and has been broken for a long time."
            2. _alitur43_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I tried this app a couple of years ago as I loved it on my laptop, and I decided to try it again because I assumed that by now they should have fixed the iPad/iPhone functionality up a bit. I was wrong. I actually don't understand how you can have such an appalling usability as an app but be so good on the web, and continue to stay unusable as an app for years at a time despite all the reviews telling you how bad your app is. I can't access templates (FREE templates) on my iPad, it takes me 30 seconds to open old notes, the dashboard and sidebar glitch around once a minute, I struggle to load things up, it drains my battery stupidly quickly and don't even get me STARTED on trying to type things/use the keyboard. Seriously, why is it so hard to do literally anything on the app? The degree to which things STILL don't work after 2 years is surreal to me."
            3. _zac-attac_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "I have paid for the Notion Plus subscription for some time. I was worried when they introduced AI features but I stuck with it because I liked the product and they had been good so far. I regret that now. The app is still horrible and slow on mobile, nearly as bad on desktop, buggy, doesn’t give power users the features they need. STILL I paid for my subscription even though the app never improved. But today is the straw that broke the camel’s back: I pay for Plus but I can’t retrieve document versions older than 90 days without paying even MORE for an Enterprise plan? I’m going to be getting my things off this platform as soon as possible. I can’t support this anymore. If the app gets overhauled, I’ll check in again. But I can’t put up with no improvements AND being nickel-and-dimed for basic features that should be included in my subscription. You had a great idea and you’ve run it into the ground."
<!--/ir-theme-->
